classification.reason: The README describes DeepSeek Harness as an agent harness with a plugin-based architecture and a locally served Web UI, making agent orchestration its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加用户消息侧边导航条，支持预览、阅读位置跟踪、键盘操作和点击跳转。
summaries.en: Adds a right-side user-message navigator to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with previews, reading-position tracking, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that adds a right-side navigator for user messages with previews, reading-position tracking, keyboard navigation, and click-to-jump history loading.

summaries.zh: 用于规划图像、视频、音频和3D生成流程，选择模型并生成提示词、参数和分镜，也可选择性通过Atlas Cloud MCP执行工作流。
summaries.en: Plans image, video, audio, and 3D generation workflows by selecting models and preparing prompts, parameters, and storyboards, with optional Atlas Cloud MCP execution.

classification.reason: A media workflow plugin that plans model selection, prompts, parameters, and storyboards for image, video, audio, and 3D generation, with optional Atlas Cloud MCP execution that can upload media and submit potentially billable operations.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏中展示当前会话的令牌用量、预估费用和 API 余额，并支持货币切换与定时刷新。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar dashboard for viewing current-session token usage, estimated costs, and API balance with currency selection and periodic refresh.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that monitors current-session token usage, estimates costs, and displays the account API balance in a sidebar dashboard with periodic refresh.

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件精选目录，帮助用户浏览社区插件并获取安装信息。
summaries.en: A curated DeepSeek Harness plugin directory for browsing community plugins and finding installation information.

classification.reason: The README identifies this repository as a curated, searchable list of DeepSeek Harness plugins with installation references rather than a plugin providing runtime functionality.

summaries.zh: 通过实时搜索 GitHub 上的 DSH 插件，为用户提供按星标排序的结果、简介、仓库链接和安装命令。
summaries.en: Searches GitHub for DSH plugins and returns star-ranked results with descriptions, repository links, and installation commands.

classification.reason: The plugin searches GitHub for DSH plugins, ranks results by stars, provides descriptions and repository links, and generates installation commands; its primary purpose is plugin discovery through search.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 CodeBuddy 中国区模型，支持 WorkBuddy API Key 或 CodeBuddy 账号令牌认证及模型目录配置。
summaries.en: Adds a CodeBuddy China provider to DeepSeek Harness with WorkBuddy API key or CodeBuddy account-token authentication and configurable model discovery.

classification.reason: A DSH provider adapter that connects users to CodeBuddy China models through WorkBuddy API keys or CodeBuddy account tokens, with model discovery and configuration in the WebUI.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 对话统计行中实时计算并显示 DeepSeek 的人民币和美元用量费用及分档明细。
summaries.en: Calculates and displays DeepSeek conversation costs in Chinese yuan and US dollars, with pricing-tier details, in the DSH Web conversation statistics row.

classification.reason: 该插件读取 DSH 对话用量事件，按模型、缓存命中状态和峰谷时段计算费用，并将结果显示在 Web 对话统计行中；主要用途是用量数据处理与费用展示。

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 会话页添加 GALgame 风格对话视图和可编辑的场景元素布局。
summaries.en: Adds a GALgame-style conversation view and an editable scene-element layout to the DSH Web GUI session page.

classification.reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that adds a GALgame-style conversation view and a visual scene editor, with user state stored in browser storage.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面增强版本，用于整理长任务进度、折叠运行详情、改进会话查找并展示生成文件入口。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web-interface enhancement that organizes long-task progress, collapses execution details, improves session discovery, and exposes generated-file entry points.

classification.reason: A web-interface variant of DeepSeek Harness focused on making long agent tasks easier to follow through collapsible progress details, readable answers, session navigation, and generated-file entry points.

summaries.zh: 通过 OAuth 将 ChatGPT Codex 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，并支持浏览器或终端登录及本地凭据存储。
summaries.en: An OAuth adapter that connects a ChatGPT Codex subscription to DeepSeek Harness with browser or terminal login and local credential storage.

classification.reason: An OAuth adapter that connects a ChatGPT Codex subscription to DeepSeek Harness, with browser or terminal login and local credential storage; human review is appropriate because it handles account credentials and describes unofficial third-party subscription use.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读的 TypeScript/JavaScript 代码变更影响分析插件，可比较 Git 变更、追踪受影响模块、提供证据位置并排序候选测试。
summaries.en: A read-only TypeScript/JavaScript change-impact analysis plugin that compares Git changes, traces affected modules, provides evidence locations, and ranks candidate tests.

classification.reason: A read-only TypeScript/JavaScript change-impact analysis plugin that compares Git revisions, traces affected modules, reports evidence, and ranks candidate tests.

summaries.zh: 一个通过分析需求文档、澄清歧义并生成经过检查的 Mermaid 技术契约来帮助编码代理在编程前完成意图对齐的 MCP 插件。
summaries.en: An MCP plugin that helps coding agents align with requirements before implementation by analyzing PRDs, resolving ambiguities, and generating linted Mermaid-based technical contracts.

classification.reason: The README presents intent-gate primarily as a requirements-planning workflow that analyzes PRDs, resolves ambiguities with human input, produces Mermaid-based technical contracts, persists review state, and lints the result before coding begins.

summaries.zh: 用于浏览 DeepSeek Harness 插件生态的双语可视化看板，提供统计卡片、图表、搜索筛选和插件详情查看。
summaries.en: A bilingual visualization dashboard for exploring the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem with statistics, charts, searchable filters, and plugin details.

classification.reason: A bilingual dashboard for exploring the DeepSeek Harness plugin ecosystem through statistics, charts, searchable plugin listings, filtering, and GitHub API refresh.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供调用阿里云通义千问或火山方舟服务生成图片的 image_generate 工具，支持文生图及部分图生图参数。
summaries.en: Provides an image_generate tool for agents to create images through configured Qwen or Volcano Ark providers, with text-to-image and limited reference-image support.

classification.reason: The README clearly describes an agent-facing image generation tool that calls configured Qwen and Volcano Ark providers and returns generated image URLs.

summaries.zh: Amber Protocol 是一个面向 AI 辅助工程的仓库本地治理工具，用于规划、审批、验证、记录和交接开发工作。
summaries.en: Amber Protocol is a repository-local governance tool for planning, approving, verifying, documenting, and handing off AI-assisted engineering work.

classification.reason: Amber Protocol is a repository-local governance CLI for planning, gating, verifying, documenting, and handing off AI-assisted engineering work without executing project workflows.

summaries.zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 的 UI 设计工作流编排插件，用于生成设计规范、执行审查并通过可选的浏览器预览和运行时证据完成验收闭环。
summaries.en: A Claude Code and Codex plugin that orchestrates a constrained UI design workflow for producing specifications, running reviews, and optionally collecting browser previews and runtime evidence for acceptance.

classification.reason: The README describes a Claude Code and Codex plugin whose primary purpose is to orchestrate a constrained, reviewable UI design pipeline covering baseline discovery, reference intake, UX specification, planning, component selection, craft checks, previews, evidence capture, and acceptance recirculation.

summaries.zh: 通过官方 ACP 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体配置接入 OpenClaw，并把已配置消息渠道中的对话转发到 Harness。
summaries.en: Connects a DeepSeek Harness agent profile to OpenClaw through the official ACP transport and routes conversations from configured messaging channels to Harness.

classification.reason: A native integration bundle that connects DeepSeek Harness to OpenClaw via ACP and routes configured messaging conversations, including WeChat through an external channel plugin.

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness 是一个基于插件架构的智能体工作台，可通过命令行启动本地 Web 界面来运行智能体工作流。
summaries.en: DeepSeek Harness is a plugin-based agent harness for running agent workflows through a locally hosted web UI and CLI.

classification.reason: DeepSeek Harness is an agent harness whose primary user-facing purpose is orchestrating plugin-based agent workflows through a local web UI and CLI.

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件精选目录，按功能分类整理插件以便浏览和发现。
summaries.en: A curated directory of DeepSeek Harness plugins organized by function for browsing and discovery.

classification.reason: The README describes a curated, categorized list of DeepSeek Harness plugins intended for browsing and discovery; it does not provide evidence that this repository itself executes plugin capabilities.

summaries.zh: 将 Word、PPT、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 等文件转换为 GitHub-Flavored Markdown。
summaries.en: Convert Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files into GitHub-Flavored Markdown.

classification.reason: The README clearly describes an Agent tool that converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files into GitHub-Flavored Markdown, with optional local output-file writing.

summaries.zh: 将 Trellis 任务驱动开发工作流集成到 DeepSeek Harness，提供规划、实现、验证、会话状态注入、子代理协作和项目脚手架命令。
summaries.en: Integrates the Trellis task-driven development workflow into DeepSeek Harness with planning, implementation, verification, session-state injection, subagent collaboration, and project scaffolding commands.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration that provides Trellis-based task planning, implementation, verification, session state injection, commands, subagent workflows, and .trellis scaffolding for software projects.

summaries.zh: 用于在 Windows 和 macOS 上双击启动 DeepSeek Harness、本地运行服务并通过独立的 Chrome 或 Edge 应用窗口访问。
summaries.en: A Windows and macOS desktop launcher that starts DeepSeek Harness locally and opens it in an isolated Chrome or Edge application window.

classification.reason: A Windows and macOS desktop launcher that starts DeepSeek Harness locally, opens it in an isolated Chrome or Edge application window, persists local sessions, and stops the service when the window closes.

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness 是一个采用插件化架构并通过本地 Web UI 使用的智能体编排框架。
summaries.en: DeepSeek Harness is an agent orchestration framework with a plugin-based architecture and a locally served Web UI.

classification.reason: The README describes DeepSeek Harness as an open-source agent harness with a plugin-based architecture and a locally served Web UI, supporting orchestration as its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面外壳，支持嵌入式界面、主题同步、系统托盘行为和本地进程管理。
summaries.en: A Windows desktop shell for an installed DeepSeek Harness, providing an embedded interface, theme synchronization, tray behavior, and local process management.

classification.reason: A Windows desktop shell for launching and embedding an installed DeepSeek Harness, with theme synchronization, tray behavior, and local process lifecycle management.

summaries.zh: 将当前 DeepSeek Harness 对话导出为 Markdown、PDF 或长 PNG 图片。
summaries.en: Export the current DeepSeek Harness conversation as Markdown, PDF, or a long PNG image.

classification.reason: The README clearly describes a browser plugin that exports the active DeepSeek Harness conversation into Markdown, PDF, or PNG artifacts through a session-header menu.

summaries.zh: 在当前对话中提供支持大小写和整词匹配的文本搜索、结果高亮及跳转导航。
summaries.en: Provides in-conversation text search with case and whole-word matching, result highlighting, and navigation through the active transcript.

classification.reason: A browser-side search utility for finding, highlighting, and navigating text within the currently rendered conversation, including content that changes during streaming.

summaries.zh: 通过 Playwright 驱动浏览器，帮助智能体导航网页、填写表单、执行页面交互、提取内容并截图。
summaries.en: A Playwright-powered browser automation plugin that lets agents navigate web pages, interact with forms and controls, extract content, run page scripts, and capture screenshots.

classification.reason: The README clearly describes a Playwright-powered browser tool family for navigating real web pages, performing UI actions, extracting page content, evaluating page JavaScript, and capturing screenshots.

summaries.zh: 将 Claude Code 市场中的插件、技能、命令和代理导入 DeepSeek Harness，并注册为可调用的 dsh 技能。
summaries.en: Imports Claude Code marketplace plugins, skills, commands, and agents into DeepSeek Harness as callable dsh skills.

classification.reason: A compatibility bridge that imports Claude Code marketplace plugins, skills, commands, and agents into DeepSeek Harness as callable dsh skills.

summaries.zh: 用于查询 DeepSeek 账户余额并汇总 DeepSeek Harness 活跃会话的令牌使用情况。
summaries.en: Monitors DeepSeek account balances and summarizes token usage across active DeepSeek Harness sessions.

classification.reason: The README documents model-callable tools for querying DeepSeek account balances and monitoring token usage across live harness sessions, making notifications-monitoring the primary category.

summaries.zh: 在文件编辑成功后运行用户配置的类型检查器或代码检查器，并将诊断结果附加到同一工具结果中。
summaries.en: Runs user-configured linters or type checkers after successful file edits and attaches their diagnostics to the same tool result.

classification.reason: Post-edit diagnostics plugin that runs configured linters or type checkers for edited files and attaches their findings to the same tool result without vetoing or rewriting the edit.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的惰性 MCP 代理，通过两个工具按需发现并调用已配置 MCP 服务器中的工具。
summaries.en: A lazy MCP proxy for DeepSeek Harness that discovers and invokes tools from configured MCP servers through two fixed tools.

classification.reason: Provides a lazy MCP proxy that exposes discovery and invocation of configured external MCP server tools while caching their catalog to reduce prompt context usage.

summaries.zh: 通过本地SQLite数据库保存跨会话记忆，并提供记忆写入、搜索、删除及提示词召回功能。
summaries.en: Provides durable cross-session memory through a local SQLite database with tools for writing, searching, deleting, and recalling stored facts.

classification.reason: A local SQLite-backed memory plugin that persists cross-session facts, exposes write/search/delete tools, and recalls selected memories in the prompt.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码审查、简化、计划执行、测试优先和冲突解决等工程实践技能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with engineering-practice skills for code review, simplification, plan-then-execute, test-first development, and conflict resolution.

classification.reason: A bundled engineering skill provider focused primarily on review, testing discipline, debugging-related conflict resolution, and structured development procedures; the README describes static Markdown skills with read-only local access and no network use.

summaries.zh: 一个只读文件扫描插件，用于在配置的工作区路径中检测疑似泄露的密钥、令牌、私钥和危险凭据文件，并以脱敏形式报告结果。
summaries.en: A read-only file-scanning plugin that detects suspected leaked keys, tokens, private keys, and credential-bearing files in configured workspace paths and reports redacted findings.

classification.reason: A read-only filesystem tool that scans configured workspace paths for leaked secrets and dangerous credential-bearing files, then reports redacted findings.

summaries.zh: 通过 Telegram Bot API 将获授权的聊天连接到 DeepSeek Harness 智能体会话，并转发文本消息与助手回复。
summaries.en: Connects authorized Telegram chats to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and forwards text messages and assistant responses through the Telegram Bot API.

classification.reason: A Telegram protocol adapter that connects authorized Telegram chats to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, forwarding text messages and streamed assistant responses through the Telegram Bot API.

summaries.zh: 通过受认证的HTTP webhook接收外部服务消息，将其转发到DeepSeek Harness智能体会话，并可选地回传智能体响应。
summaries.en: Receives authenticated HTTP webhooks from external services, forwards messages to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, and optionally sends responses back to a callback URL.

classification.reason: An HTTP webhook bridge that receives messages from CI, monitoring, bots, and other services, forwards them to DeepSeek Harness agent sessions, and optionally posts responses to a callback URL.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 对话框的模型选择区域显示 DeepSeek V4 Pro 或 V4 Flash 的 codexradar IQ 值，并按模型、思考档位和定时周期刷新。
summaries.en: Displays the codexradar IQ value for the selected DeepSeek V4 Pro or V4 Flash model in the DSH composer and refreshes it when the model, reasoning effort, or refresh interval changes.

classification.reason: A DSH UI plugin that displays the selected DeepSeek V4 Pro or V4 Flash model's codexradar IQ value and refreshes it from a read-only external API.

summaries.zh: 在设置页为第三方模型配置思考努力度档位、默认路由档位及适用的 Anthropic token 预算，并同步到模型选择器。
summaries.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels, default routing levels, and applicable Anthropic token budgets for third-party models from the settings page and model picker.

classification.reason: A settings utility for configuring reasoning-effort levels, default routing, and Anthropic token budgets for third-party models, with changes persisted in the llm-pi-ai settings namespace.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供由 Orchestrator 调度多个专职子代理完成调查、决策、执行与验证的多智能体编排模式。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset that coordinates specialized subagents across investigation, decision-making, execution, and verification workflows.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness agent preset centered on orchestrating specialized agents through investigation, decision, execution, and verification workflows, with routing, budgets, receipts, optional persistence, and status metrics.

summaries.zh: 一组为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解、图像生成及统计显示优化功能的插件集合。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle providing image understanding, image generation with local saving, and a statistics display enhancement.

classification.reason: A bundle of three user-facing plugins focused primarily on image capabilities: vision analysis, image generation with local saving, and a minor statistics display adjustment. The README provides sufficient evidence for a media-tools classification and documents external API and local file capabilities.

summaries.zh: 为DSH提供插件安装页面，可从上传的清单文件或Git仓库安装、热加载、持久化管理和移除动态插件。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH settings page for installing, hot-loading, persisting, updating, and removing dynamic plugins from uploaded manifests or Git repositories.

classification.reason: The README describes a DSH plugin installer that adds a settings page for installing, hot-loading, persisting, updating, and removing dynamic plugins from uploaded packages or Git repositories.

summaries.zh: 一个面向 Windows 的免安装启动器，用于打包运行环境、启动本地 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面并通过系统托盘管理服务。
summaries.en: A portable Windows launcher that bundles the runtime, starts a local DeepSeek Harness web interface, opens it in the default browser, and provides system-tray process management.

classification.reason: A Windows one-click launcher that bundles the runtime for DeepSeek Harness, starts its local web interface, opens it in the default browser, and manages the process from the system tray.

summaries.zh: 用于为 DSH 插件和技能运行 YAML 用例回归评测、检查会话轨迹与输出、对比基线并生成 CI 门禁结果。
summaries.en: Runs YAML-defined regression evaluations for DSH plugins and skills, checks session traces and outputs, compares baselines, and produces CI gate results.

classification.reason: A regression evaluation harness for DSH plugins and skills that runs YAML-defined cases against real headless agents, asserts session traces and outputs, compares baselines, and produces CI gate results.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 会话连接到微信，用于远程接收任务状态和审批通知、回复审批并注入文本指令。
summaries.en: Connects DSH sessions to WeChat for remote task updates, approval responses, and text command injection.

classification.reason: Bridges DSH sessions with WeChat for remote task monitoring, approval responses, and text injection, with persistent deduplication and message buffering.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供安洁莉娜亮色与暗色主题、磨砂玻璃样式和可选视差背景效果。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with Angelina-inspired light and dark themes, frosted-glass styling, and optional parallax background effects.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on Angelina-themed light and dark visual styling, glass effects, and optional parallax presentation without changing the host conversation layout or controls.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的菜单、面板、对话框、标签页和工作区状态提供克制且遵循减少动态效果设置的界面动效。
summaries.en: Adds restrained, semantic animations to DeepSeek Harness menus, panels, dialogs, tabs, and workspace states while respecting reduced-motion preferences.

classification.reason: A zero-configuration browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds restrained semantic interface motion while preserving host layout control and reduced-motion preferences.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 文档整理为支持搜索、翻译、目录导航和对话面板的本地网页阅读界面。
summaries.en: A local web reading interface that organizes DSH documentation with search, translation, table-of-contents navigation, and an adjacent conversation panel.

classification.reason: A DSH profile and plugin bundle that presents curated DSH documentation in a searchable, translatable web reader with table-of-contents navigation and an adjacent conversation panel.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 中选择对话范围并将其渲染为可预览、下载或复制的 PNG 长图。
summaries.en: Select a range of a DSH Web conversation and render it as a previewable PNG long image for download or clipboard copying.

classification.reason: A DSH Web interface plugin that lets users select part of a conversation and render it as a shareable PNG with preview, download, and clipboard-copy options.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供桌面浏览器通知，在需要审批、回答问题或回合完成时提醒用户，并支持点击通知返回相关会话。
summaries.en: Adds desktop browser notifications to the DSH Web UI for approvals, questions, and turn completion, with click-through navigation to the related session.

classification.reason: A DSH Web UI plugin that sends contextual desktop browser notifications for approvals, questions, interruptions, errors, and completed turns, with click-through navigation to the related session.

summaries.zh: 通过本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程，为模型提供控制用户真实浏览器、操作页面和管理标签页的工具。
summaries.en: Provides model tools for controlling the user's real browser through a local Kimi WebBridge daemon, including page interaction and tab management.

classification.reason: The README describes a DSH adapter that exposes model tools for controlling the user's real browser through a local Kimi WebBridge daemon, including navigation, page interaction, JavaScript evaluation, screenshots, network inspection, and tab management.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跟随工作区的项目文件树，并支持在界面中预览代码、文本、图片、音视频和 PDF 文件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness project file explorer that follows the active workspace and previews code, text, images, audio, video, and PDF files in the interface.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness project file explorer that provides a docked workspace file tree, in-app previews for common file and media types, and related installation patches.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 用户提供按功能分类的插件精选目录，帮助发现界面、工作流、记忆、工具和集成类插件。
summaries.en: A curated, categorized directory that helps DeepSeek Harness users discover plugins for interface, workflows, memory, tools, integrations, and development.

classification.reason: A curated, categorized directory of DeepSeek Harness plugins intended to help users discover plugins across interface, workflow, memory, tools, integrations, and development use cases.

summaries.zh: 面向基因组学、病原体和生物信息学项目的科研工作台，提供研究循环、实验与成果溯源管理，以及经审批的 SSH/HPC 远程计算。
summaries.en: A scientific research workbench for genomics, pathogen, and bioinformatics projects that provides research loops, provenance-aware artifact management, and approval-gated SSH/HPC remote computation.

classification.reason: A scientific research workbench centered on ReAct research workflows, experiment and artifact provenance, bioinformatics skills, and optional SSH/HPC remote computation; human review is warranted because it can execute jobs on external hosts and modify project files.

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness plugin: open the Web GUI in a native macOS desktop window (SwiftUI + WKWebView).
summaries.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: open the Web GUI in a native macOS desktop window (SwiftUI + WKWebView).

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: provider-group collapse + name search for the conversation model picker.
summaries.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: provider-group collapse + name search for the conversation model picker.

summaries.zh: Skills management page for DeepSeek Harness Web Settings (dsh plugin)
summaries.en: Skills management page for DeepSeek Harness Web Settings (dsh plugin)

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中让智能体向其他实时会话发起有上下文的咨询，并通过分叉会话、共享任务板和异步回复协同工作。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets Agents consult live peer Sessions with shared context, forked channels, task boards, and asynchronous replies.

classification.reason: The README describes a host plugin for coordinating live Agent Sessions through peer consultation, forked channels, shared task boards, asynchronous replies, and explicit alignment with an original Session; orchestration is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 中渲染的 KaTeX 数学公式提供便捷的 LaTeX 复制和格式选择交互。
summaries.en: Adds convenient LaTeX copying and format selection interactions for rendered KaTeX formulas in DeepSeek Harness Web.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web utility that lets users copy rendered KaTeX formulas as LaTeX in several common delimiters, with mouse and keyboard interactions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 记录会话活动并以成就徽章、进度面板和解锁提示呈现使用轨迹的游戏化插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness gamification plugin that tracks session activity and presents achievement badges, progress panels, and unlock notifications.

classification.reason: A gamification and activity-visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness that tracks session events, presents achievement badges and progress in a settings panel, and emits unlock notifications.

summaries.zh: 将 Markdown 内容转换为带主题、键盘导航和全屏控制的自包含 HTML 演示文稿。
summaries.en: Converts Markdown content into self-contained HTML presentations with selectable themes, keyboard navigation, and fullscreen controls.

classification.reason: A presentation-generation tool that converts Markdown into self-contained HTML slides with selectable themes, navigation, and local file output; the README states that it uses no network or external assets.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供可配置的合成音效、提示音、静音控制和完成时的彩纸效果。
summaries.en: Adds configurable synthesized sounds, session alerts, mute controls, and completion confetti to DeepSeek Harness sessions.

classification.reason: Adds synthesized audio feedback, optional typing ambience, and confetti effects to DeepSeek Harness sessions, with persistent controls and a cross-plugin soundscape service; the README states it uses no audio assets or network requests.

summaries.zh: DSH Remote 提供手机和桌面端远程控制台，用于查看和继续会话、处理审批与提问、传输文件并监控主机与网关状态。
summaries.en: DSH Remote provides mobile and desktop consoles for viewing and continuing DSH sessions, handling approvals and questions, transferring files, and monitoring host and gateway status.

classification.reason: A mobile and desktop remote console for DSH, centered on session control, approval and question handling, file transfer, notifications, and host or gateway status monitoring.

summaries.zh: 将本地 claude-mem 工作器集成到 DeepSeek Harness，用于搜索、检索、保存、注入和可选汇总跨会话记忆。
summaries.en: Integrates a local claude-mem worker with DeepSeek Harness for searching, retrieving, saving, injecting, and optionally summarizing cross-session memory.

classification.reason: Integrates a local claude-mem worker with DeepSeek Harness to search, retrieve, save, inject, ingest, and summarize persistent session memory.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体的部分高风险工具调用增加模型审查、拒绝或升级流程，并提供外部模型路由与按请求计费功能。
summaries.en: This plugin adds model-based review, denial, or escalation for selected high-risk tool calls in DeepSeek Harness agents, along with external model routing and per-request billing.

classification.reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is orchestrating agent tool execution through a model-based review gate for selected dangerous actions, with additional external model routing and usage billing features.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可配置的全局键盘快捷键、改键设置、冲突检测以及常用界面操作绑定。
summaries.en: Adds configurable global keyboard shortcuts, key remapping, conflict detection, and bindings for common DeepSeek Harness web interface actions.

classification.reason: A browser UI plugin that adds configurable global keyboard shortcuts, shortcut recording and conflict detection, and bindings for common DeepSeek Harness interface actions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供局域网反向代理、应用内工作区目录选择器和 UUID 兼容补丁，但控制面板无认证，仅应在可信局域网中使用。
summaries.en: Provides LAN reverse proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with an in-app workspace directory picker and UUID compatibility polyfill, but the unauthenticated control plane should only be used on trusted LANs.

classification.reason: Provides LAN access to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI through a reverse proxy, with an in-app directory picker and UUID polyfill; the README explicitly states that the unauthenticated control plane exposes remote code execution to reachable LAN clients, requiring human security review.

summaries.zh: 在结案前运行工作区验证命令并记录结果，且在发生修改后要求重新验证的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin that runs workspace verification commands, records their results, and requires fresh successful verification before work can be concluded.

classification.reason: A verification gate plugin that runs workspace tests or configured commands, records their results, and requires a fresh successful verification before work can be concluded.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh web 提供自动启动服务、打开默认浏览器以及 Windows 系统托盘和桌面快捷方式等桌面集成功能。
summaries.en: Provides desktop integration for dsh web by launching the service, opening the default browser, and adding Windows tray and desktop shortcut features.

classification.reason: The README describes a desktop integration plugin for dsh web that launches the local service, opens it in the default browser, and adds Windows tray, shortcut, and console-management features.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示会话费用、每日累计支出和账户余额的监控插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that displays session costs, daily spending, and account balance in a floating monitoring panel.

classification.reason: The README describes a DSH web plugin whose primary purpose is monitoring estimated DeepSeek API spending and account balance through a floating interface.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 搜索、检查并可选安装 DeepSeek Harness 插件，并在启用运行时后调用其工具。
summaries.en: An MCP bridge for searching and inspecting DeepSeek Harness plugins, optionally installing them, and calling their tools when runtime access is enabled.

classification.reason: An MCP bridge for discovering, inspecting, optionally installing, and running DeepSeek Harness plugins, with installation and runtime execution explicitly opt-in.

summaries.zh: 通过 ACP v1 将 dsh 会话连接到 BitFun，使模型能够调用可配置的 subagent_bitfun 工具委托任务执行。
summaries.en: Connects dsh sessions to BitFun through ACP v1 so models can delegate tasks using a configurable subagent_bitfun tool.

classification.reason: The plugin connects dsh sessions to BitFun as a delegated subagent through ACP v1 over stdio, exposing a configurable subagent tool and managing BitFun subprocesses for task execution.

summaries.zh: 通过博查 Web Search API 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索结果的搜索提供插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness search provider that retrieves web results from the Bocha Web Search API.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness WebSearchProvider that queries Bocha's web search API and maps bounded results into the Harness web_search contract.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 /cost 命令和可拖拽悬浮面板查看会话的模型、Token 用量及估算费用。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the current session model, token usage, and estimated cost through a /cost command and draggable floating panel.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for monitoring session token usage and estimated costs through a /cost command and a draggable floating web UI panel.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中查看上下文组成、统计、演进事件、消息及请求内容的可视化上下文管理插件。
summaries.en: A visual context management plugin for DeepSeek Harness that displays context composition, statistics, lifecycle events, messages, and assembled request contents.

classification.reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin for inspecting and managing agent context through a dashboard, context browser, statistics, lifecycle events, and an in-session command.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简洁的终端对话界面，用于输入消息、查看模型回答、显示运行状态并按需检查工具调用详情。
summaries.en: A compact terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness that accepts messages, renders model answers and activity status, and optionally shows retained tool-call details.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness terminal presentation plugin focused on compact conversational layout, response rendering, status display, and optional tool-detail inspection; the README also documents a current-user Windows context-menu installer.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中按消息统计 token 使用与费用，管理本地账本、余额和预算，并通过浏览器页面查看或导出账单。
summaries.en: Tracks per-message token usage and billing in DeepSeek Harness, manages a local ledger, balance, and budget, and provides browser views and exports for cost records.

classification.reason: The plugin primarily processes local DSH message events into token-usage and billing records, then presents dashboards, balances, budgets, and exports; it also queries the documented DeepSeek balance endpoint.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中浏览、搜索、安装、更新和卸载来自 GitHub 的 DSH 插件与通用 Skills。
summaries.en: Browse, search, install, update, and uninstall DSH plugins and general skills from GitHub within the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.

classification.reason: The README describes a DSH Web GUI marketplace for discovering GitHub plugins and skills, with search, metadata browsing, installation, updates, and removal. It can clone repositories, modify local DSH files and registrations, execute third-party installation or npm scripts, handle user-provided environment values, and access GitHub and WebDAV, so human review is appropriate for its R2 risk profile.

summaries.zh: 在 Chrome 或 Chromium 中标注页面元素，收集 DOM、样式、可访问性信息、评论和可选截图，并将结构化反馈发送给智能体。
summaries.en: Annotates elements in Chrome or Chromium, captures DOM, style, accessibility data, comments, and optional screenshots, and sends structured feedback to an agent.

classification.reason: A browser annotation plugin for collecting structured visual and accessibility feedback from selected page elements and sending it to an agent for UI debugging.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可复用的 Markdown 提示配置，支持参数替换、单轮模型选择以及调用后的状态恢复。
summaries.en: Provides reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with argument substitution, per-turn model selection, and restoration of the previous agent state.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for reusable prompt profiles, argument substitution, scoped per-turn model selection, and restoration of the prior agent selection.

summaries.zh: 在终端中交互式审查 Git 差异，支持对代码行添加结构化批注并将审查结果提交回当前 Agent 会话。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal plugin for reviewing Git diffs, adding structured line annotations, and submitting review feedback to the current Agent session.

classification.reason: An interactive terminal plugin for reviewing Git diffs, annotating changed lines, and returning structured review feedback to the current Agent session.

summaries.zh: 在 dsh 网页界面中通过服务端代理获取配置提供商的余额或用量，并以可刷新状态面板展示。
summaries.en: Displays configured provider balance or usage data in a refreshable dsh web-surface status panel through server-side proxy routes.

classification.reason: A dsh web-surface monitoring plugin that retrieves configured provider balance or usage data through server-side proxy routes and displays it in a refreshable status panel.

summaries.zh: 一个用于浏览、筛选和发现 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件的精选目录。
summaries.en: A curated directory for browsing, filtering, and discovering community plugins for DeepSeek Harness.

classification.reason: The README describes a curated, categorized directory for discovering DeepSeek Harness plugins, including recommendations, rankings, full catalog browsing, and machine-readable metadata; it does not present an executable plugin capability.

summaries.zh: 一款面向 DSH 的第三方 Electron 桌面客户端，提供托盘常驻、后台任务、通知、运行时连接以及插件市场管理。
summaries.en: A third-party Electron desktop client for DSH that provides tray persistence, background tasks, notifications, runtime connections, and plugin marketplace management.

classification.reason: A third-party Electron desktop client for DSH focused on persistent local task execution, desktop notifications, runtime management, and plugin marketplace workflows; the README also documents agent command and file access, warranting R2 risk.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供支持浅色和深色模式的纯色、渐变及图片背景自定义，并可将设置持久化到本地配置文件。
summaries.en: Customizes DeepSeek Harness Web UI backgrounds with light and dark mode colors, gradients, and images, with settings persisted in a local configuration file.

classification.reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness Web UI background customization plugin supporting theme-aware colors, gradients, images, sidebar application, and persistent settings; human review is warranted because installation patches product files and writes local configuration.

summaries.zh: Morning Star 是一个面向软件交付的智能体工作流插件，用于通过计划、派发、迭代、评审、验收和代码库审计流程协调多智能体协作。
summaries.en: Morning Star is an agent workflow plugin for coordinating software delivery through planning, dispatch, iteration, review, QA, and codebase-audit workflows.

classification.reason: Morning Star is an agent workflow engine and plugin for coordinating multi-agent software delivery through deterministic planning, dispatch, iteration, review, QA, and codebase-audit workflows.

summaries.zh: 用于开发 DeepSeek Harness 插件的最小 TypeScript 模板，包含插件注册、构建和运行所需的基础结构。
summaries.en: A minimal TypeScript template for developing DeepSeek Harness plugins with basic registration, build, and runtime structure.

classification.reason: A minimal TypeScript DeepSeek Harness plugin template intended to help developers create, register, build, and run plugins; the README evidences only profile registration and a hello-world startup message.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 生成、运行并在有限迭代内修复项目单元测试。
summaries.en: Generates, runs, and iteratively fixes project unit tests within a bounded loop for DeepSeek Harness.

classification.reason: The README clearly presents a testing plugin that generates unit tests, runs project test runners, parses failures, and fixes only its generated test files through a bounded loop.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 当前会话导出为可移植的 Markdown 和结构化 JSON 文件。
summaries.en: Exports the current DeepSeek Harness session as portable Markdown and structured JSON files.

classification.reason: The plugin exports the current DeepSeek Harness session into portable Markdown and versioned JSON files, with tool and slash-command entry points.

summaries.zh: 根据会话阶段在对话、规划和实施过程中自动路由模型，并可配置实施阶段的触发工具。
summaries.en: Automatically routes models across conversation, planning, and implementation stages, with configurable tools that trigger the implementation model.

classification.reason: The README describes a plugin that automatically switches between faster and more capable models as a session moves from conversation or planning into implementation, making planning and execution control its primary purpose.

summaries.zh: 通过本地网页界面查看并删除 DeepSeek Harness 会话，同时清理相关存储记录并支持删除前备份。
summaries.en: A local web-based utility for viewing and deleting DeepSeek Harness sessions while cleaning related storage records and optionally creating backups.

classification.reason: A local browser-based utility for inspecting and deleting DeepSeek Harness sessions, including related storage cleanup, optional backups, and post-deletion verification.

summaries.zh: 面向法律事务的工作区插件，提供文件索引与搜索、文档预览和提取、DOCX/PDF 生成与修订、可选 OCR 及任务跟踪功能。
summaries.en: A legal matter workspace plugin for file indexing and search, document preview and extraction, DOCX/PDF creation and revision, optional OCR, and task tracking.

classification.reason: A matter-aware legal workspace focused primarily on indexing, previewing, extracting, revising, and generating legal documents, with optional OCR and task tracking.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 回合结束或等待用户确认时，通过浏览器、系统通知及多种 Webhook 渠道发送提醒的消息通知插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness notification plugin that alerts users on turn completion or pending confirmation through browser, system, and configurable webhook channels.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that notifies users when turns finish or approval and question events await input, using browser, host-system, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and generic webhook channels.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏显示基于北京时间的峰谷定价时段徽章，并支持中英文界面切换。
summaries.en: Displays a Beijing-time peak or off-peak pricing badge in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar with Chinese and English interface text.

classification.reason: A UI-only sidebar plugin that displays Beijing-time peak or off-peak pricing status, with periodic local updates and bilingual text.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 添加可拖动的桌面电子宠物，根据 agent 状态显示动画，并支持自定义图片、精灵图和本地互动成长记录。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable desktop pet overlay to DeepSeek Harness Web GUI that reflects agent states with animations and supports custom images, sprite sheets, and local interaction progress.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a draggable desktop pet overlay, reflects agent activity through animations, supports custom media and sprite sheets, and tracks local companion interactions.

summaries.zh: 连接 DSH 与受支持的蓝牙、串口、USB 或共享链接设备，并提供发现、连接、控制、停止和断开工具。
summaries.en: Connects DSH to supported Bluetooth, serial, USB, or sharing-link devices and provides tools for discovery, connection, bounded control, stopping, and disconnection.

classification.reason: Connects DSH to supported physical devices through raw macOS BLE discovery, Intiface, or MonsterParty and exposes scan, connection, bounded control, stop, and disconnect tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可拖动、可配置的像素鲸鱼伴侣，用于展示会话状态和对话进度，并支持可选的浮动桌面窗口。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable draggable pixel whale to DeepSeek Harness that reflects session activity, shows conversation progress, and can optionally run in a floating desktop window.

classification.reason: A native DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a configurable animated whale companion, reflects structured session activity, displays current conversation progress, and optionally provides a floating desktop window.

summaries.zh: 一款适用于DSH等智能体框架的新闻简报技能，可汇总多源资讯、按标准筛选并生成中文早报或晚报。
summaries.en: A DSH-compatible skill that curates multi-source news, applies defined selection criteria, and generates structured Chinese morning or evening briefings.

classification.reason: A DSH-compatible skill for curating multi-source news, applying five-dimensional selection criteria, and producing structured Chinese morning or evening briefings.

summaries.zh: 通过 news_fetch 工具抓取 RSS 或 Atom 新闻源，并按来源、分类和数量返回结构化新闻条目。
summaries.en: Fetches configured RSS or Atom news feeds and returns structured entries filterable by source, category, and result limit.

classification.reason: The plugin registers a news_fetch tool that retrieves configured RSS or Atom sources and returns structured, filterable news entries for downstream use.

summaries.zh: 用于检索中文网络小说的剧情、章节、角色设定和更新状态，并汇总多个公开来源的信息。
summaries.en: An agent skill for searching public web sources to find and summarize Chinese web-novel plots, chapters, character details, and update status.

classification.reason: The README describes an agent skill for searching public web sources to locate and summarize Chinese web-novel plots, chapters, characters, and update status, with multi-source cross-checking.

summaries.zh: 用于在内置浏览器中预览网页、批注页面元素并进行临时视觉调整，再将结构化反馈提供给智能体修改前端源码。
summaries.en: A plugin for previewing webpages, annotating elements, testing temporary visual adjustments, and sending structured feedback to an agent for frontend source changes.

classification.reason: A web review plugin for previewing frontend pages, annotating selected elements, testing temporary visual adjustments, and supplying structured feedback to an agent for source changes.

summaries.zh: 一个在 DSH 对话完成或需要用户关注时播放提示音并显示 Windows 通知的宿主插件，支持网页端配置和通知跳转。
summaries.en: A DSH host plugin that plays configurable sound alerts and shows Windows notifications when conversations finish or require attention, with web-based settings and conversation links.

classification.reason: A DSH host plugin that monitors agent conversation states and alerts users with configurable local audio and Windows notifications, including web controls and links back to conversations.

summaries.zh: 将 AWS Kiro 账号接入 DeepSeek Harness，以使用 Kiro 提供的 Claude 和开放权重模型。
summaries.en: Connects an AWS Kiro account to DeepSeek Harness so it can use Claude and open-weight models served by Kiro.

classification.reason: An AWS Kiro adapter for DeepSeek Harness that exposes Claude and open-weight models through a Kiro account, including credential-file access, token refresh, streaming requests, and optional proxy configuration.

summaries.zh: 从 Claude Code、Kiro、OpenCode、Codex 及 Harness 配置文件中发现并合并 MCP 服务器，并将其同步挂载到 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Discovers and merges MCP server definitions from Claude Code, Kiro, OpenCode, Codex, and Harness configuration files, then synchronizes the mounted servers in DeepSeek Harness.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that discovers MCP server definitions from supported tool configuration files, merges them by precedence, and keeps the mounted server set synchronized with those files.

summaries.zh: 一款将本地图片转换为配色并应用为可调背景和玻璃风格界面的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness theme plugin that extracts colors from a local image and applies them as an adjustable background and glass-style interface theme.

classification.reason: A web-only theme customization plugin that extracts a palette from a local image, applies glass-style theme tokens, and uses the image as a configurable background; the README states that image processing and storage remain browser-local.

summaries.zh: 为文本模型提供图片分析能力，可读取本地或粘贴的图片并通过用户配置的兼容视觉端点回答问题。
summaries.en: Adds image analysis for text-only models by reading local or pasted images and querying a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint.

classification.reason: Provides an analyze_image tool that reads image paths, URLs, or pasted-image attachments and forwards them to a user-configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint for visual questions and text extraction.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供可配置专注与休息周期、侧栏入口和可拖动浮动面板的番茄钟计时器。
summaries.en: A Pomodoro timer for DeepSeek Harness Web with configurable focus and break cycles, a sidebar entry, and a draggable floating panel.

classification.reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web Pomodoro timer focused on configurable focus and break cycles, with a sidebar and draggable panel plus optional completion notifications.

summaries.zh: 一个按能力分类整理 DeepSeek Harness 插件与相关资源并提供核验、安装和兼容性参考的精选目录。
summaries.en: A curated directory of DeepSeek Harness plugins and related resources organized by capability, with verification, installation, and compatibility guidance.

classification.reason: The README describes an evidence-led directory that catalogs and categorizes DeepSeek Harness plugins and related resources, with verification status and installation guidance; it does not itself provide executable plugin functionality.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带主题、状态可视化、上下文进度和会话导航功能的交互式终端界面。
summaries.en: An interactive terminal interface for DeepSeek Harness with themes, live status visualization, context metrics, and session navigation.

classification.reason: A terminal UI plugin primarily focused on themes, layout, live status visualization, and navigation for DeepSeek Harness coding-agent sessions; it inherits the active profile's file and shell capabilities.

summaries.zh: DSH 实时模型工作状态行：俏皮思考文案、运行中的工具、回合总结、自我叙述（⏵）— 用于 TUI 提示栏与 Web UI
summaries.en: DSH 实时模型工作状态行：俏皮思考文案、运行中的工具、回合总结、自我叙述（⏵）— 用于 TUI 提示栏与 Web UI

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 右侧提供工作区面板，集成文件浏览与编辑、终端命令执行以及 Git 变更审查。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH Web side panel for browsing and editing workspace files, running terminal commands, and reviewing Git changes.

classification.reason: The README describes a DSH Web side panel whose primary user-facing purpose is workspace navigation and review, combining file browsing, terminal access, and Git change inspection.

summaries.zh: 通过费曼学习法引导模型讲解概念、发起复述练习并针对知识缺口重新讲解，同时以富 HTML 卡片展示课程内容。
summaries.en: Guides the model through Feynman-style explanations, teach-back exercises, and targeted re-explanations while displaying lessons as rich HTML cards.

classification.reason: A Feynman learning-mode plugin that guides structured explanations, teach-back questions, and targeted re-explanations, with lessons rendered as rich HTML cards.

summaries.zh: 将拖入或粘贴的图片保存到会话工作区，并在纯文本模型对话中插入图片文件路径。
summaries.en: Saves dragged or pasted images to the session workspace and inserts their file paths into conversations with text-only models.

classification.reason: The README describes a chat plugin that accepts dragged or pasted images, stores them in the session workspace, and supplies file paths to text-only models, making media-tools the primary category.
